concerns.text: SC‑001 (MAE reduction ≥ 0.05 eV vs. fingerprint baseline and paired‑test p < 0.05) is not addressed by any task; no verification step computes the GNN‑baseline MAE difference or asserts the required significance.
SC‑002 (MAE increase ≥ 0.05 eV, Cohen’s d ≥ 0.5 for feature‑importance) is missing – the ablation result schema lacks a `cohen_d` field and no task checks the MAE‑increase threshold.
FR‑025 (CI job orchestration with per‑job ≤ 6 h, ≤ 7 GB RAM limits) is not mapped to any concrete task; a task to generate and validate the GitHub Actions workflow is required.

FR‑018 (primary a priori power analysis on the full training set ≥ 20 000 molecules) is only covered by the fallback task T014; a dedicated task must run the power analysis before any training begins and abort if power < 0.8.

FR‑026 (Verified Accuracy) requires title‑token overlap ≥ 0.7 for external citations, but T001 only verifies URL/checksum; a verification step computing the overlap and failing if below threshold is missing.

T009’s attribution generation relies on a qualitative “chemical intuition” check with no measurable success criterion; a quantitative validation (e.g., correlation with known Hammett σ values or a defined pass/fail threshold) must be added.
